summary: This clipped Snowflake documentation page describes the account_root_budget!ACTIVATE method, which activates the account budget so it can track credit usage. It covers the call syntax, the return value 'activated', and the ACCOUNTADMIN-only access requirement. Usage notes say activation is irreversible, a spending limit and notification settings must be configured afterward, and custom budgets do not need activation. The page also notes the feature is not available for Trial Accounts.
one_line: Snowflake method that activates the account budget, an irreversible step requiring the ACCOUNTADMIN role.
key_facts: The account_root_budget!ACTIVATE method activates the account budget.
Syntax is CALL account_root_budget!ACTIVATE() and the method returns 'activated'.
Only a user with the ACCOUNTADMIN role can activate the account budget.
Once the account budget is activated, it cannot be deactivated.
After activation, a spending limit must be set for the budget to start tracking credit usage.
After activation, the notification integration and email address(es) must be set to receive notifications.
No notifications will be sent if email addresses are not set.
The ACTIVATE method is only available on the account budget; custom budgets do not require activation.
This feature is currently not available for Trial Accounts.
Troubleshooting information for account budget activation errors is provided on a separate page.
